sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 180. Success value 100. 3x magic damage (Dark).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 90. Confuses for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 80. Blinds for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces Unison gauge by 20.
-Target: all allies. Removes debuffs.
-Target: all allies. Reduces Ability cooldown times (except for certain Abilities) by 40% for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 8000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 8000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: your character. Applies Concerto for 60 seconds (increases max HP and all stats by 100%; increases fire, water, wind, light, dark, time, and star elemental attack by 4. If Concerto is applied to allies as well, status ailments, debuffs, Cost reduction, and Unison gauge reduction will also be nullified based on the number of members (excluding self) in Concerto state).
Only [Rampaging] Rubato can be used as Unlocking Potential material
